infotexts.YAMJCS.RaptorVisionKey.Tooltip: Button to toggle thermal vision as a raptor (requires talent).
infotexts.YAMJCS.QuickChatKey.Tooltip: Button to bring up the quickchat wheel (requires headset).
infotexts.YAMJCS.RaptorVisionColor.Tooltip: Color of "Heat Signature" thermal vision effect, in #RRGGBBAA or #RRGGBB format.
infotexts.YAMJCS.OreVisionColor.Tooltip: Color of "Bond with Mechanic" ore vision effect, in #RRGGBBAA or #RRGGBB format.
infotexts.YAMJCS.DigestionUpdateInterval.Tooltip: Time between gut digestion updates, in seconds. Does not affect rate of digestion.
infotexts.YAMJCS.CaptainProxUpdateInterval.Tooltip: Time (in seconds) between checks to see if a captain is nearby any raptors with the "Big Dog (Bond with Captain)" talent.
infotexts.YAMJCS.HungerRate.Tooltip: How much hunger a player raptor gains per second. At the default value 0.015, it should take ~90 minutes for a fully fed, healthy raptor to starve. At the max value 0.5, it takes about 3 minutes.
infotexts.YAMJCS.EatingHungerReduction.Tooltip: How much hunger is reduced per second when player raptors are eating corpses.
infotexts.YAMJCS.BasicFoodHungerReduction.Tooltip: How much a player raptor's hunger is reduced by (per second) for each piece of normal food in their gut.
infotexts.YAMJCS.EngineerFoodHungerReduction.Displ: (Bond with Engineer) Fuel Rod Hunger Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.EngineerFoodHungerReduction.Toolt: How much a player raptor's hunger is reduced by (per second) for each reactor fuel rod in their gut.
infotexts.YAMJCS.MechanicFoodHungerReduction.Displ: (Bond with Mechanic) Ore and Scrap Hunger Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.MechanicFoodHungerReduction.Toolt: How much a player raptor's hunger is reduced by (per second) for each piece of ore or scrap in their gut. Negative values make metal increase hunger rather than reduce it.
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorFoodHungerReduction.Display: (Bond with Doctor) Genetic Material Hunger Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorFoodHungerReduction.Tooltip: How much a player raptor's hunger is reduced by (per second) for each unidentified genetic sample in their gut. Negative values make genes increase hunger rather than reduce it. Negative by default.
infotexts.YAMJCS.BasicFoodConditionReduction.Toolt: How much condition normal food loses per second while in a player raptor's gut. The item is consumed once its condition reaches zero.
infotexts.YAMJCS.EngineerFoodConditionReduction.Di: (Bond with Engineer) Fuel Rod Condition Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.EngineerFoodConditionReduction.To: How much condition a reactor fuel rod loses per second while in a player raptor's gut.
infotexts.YAMJCS.MechanicFoodConditionReduction.Di: (Bond with Mechanic) Ore and Scrap Condition Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.MechanicFoodConditionReduction.To: How much condition ore and scrap lose per second while in a player raptor's gut.
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorFoodConditionReduction.Disp: (Bond with Doctor) Genetic Material Condition Reduction
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorFoodConditionReduction.Tool: How much condition unidentified genetic material loses per second while in a player raptor's gut. Negative values improve condition instead, refining the sample.
infotexts.YAMJCS.RaptorVisionRange.Tooltip: Range at which raptors with this talent can sense characters through walls.
infotexts.YAMJCS.OreVisionRange.Tooltip: Range at which player raptors can see ores (including off-screen).
infotexts.YAMJCS.RaptorVisionShowDead.Tooltip: If enabled, raptors can sense alive AND dead characters through walls when using this talent.
infotexts.YAMJCS.CanOpenerDamageBonus.Tooltip: Additional damage dealt to structures by raptors with this talent. example: 3 = +300% damage bonus.
infotexts.YAMJCS.FamiliarWatersDamageBonus.Tooltip: Outgoing damage bonus for raptors with this talent while in the water. example: 0.25 = +25% damage bonus.
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorBondBurnResist.Tooltip: Amount of burn resist (percent) given to all allies. The effect does not stack.
infotexts.YAMJCS.DoctorBondPoisonResist.Tooltip: Amount of poison resist (percent) given to all allies. The effect does not stack.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ShrapnelSpitCost.Tooltip: How much condition is taken from a piece of metal when a raptor spits it out as a shrapnel attack.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ShrapnelLacerations.Tooltip: Raptors with this talent can spray 13 pieces of shrapnel in a wide fan. This is the amount of Laceration damage each piece of shrapnel does.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ShrapnelBleeding.Tooltip: Raptors with this talent can spray 13 pieces of shrapnel in a wide fan. This is the amount of Bleeding damage each piece of shrapnel does.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteDamageBonus.DisplayNam: (Bond with Security) Charged Bite Damage Bonus
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteDamageBonus.Tooltip: Bonus damage of a fully charged creature attack. example: 0.5 = +50% damage bonus.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteStun.Tooltip: Amount of stun applied by a fully charged creature attack. On a 100 max vitality target (like humans), this is the duration of the stun in seconds. Stun duration scales inversely with max vitality; tougher creatures are stunned for less.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteCooldown.DisplayName: (Bond with Security) Charged Bite Charge Time
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteCooldown.Tooltip: Time it takes, in seconds, for the charged bite to be ready on its own.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteCooldownReward.Display: (Bond with Security) Marked Target Cooldown Reward
infotexts.YAMJCS.ChargedBiteCooldownReward.Tooltip: Creature attacks against marked targets removes this many seconds from the charged bite's cooldown.
infotexts.YAMJCS.HandlerMarkDuration.Tooltip: How long a character is considered "marked" for when damaged by a handler.
infotexts.YAMJCS.ClearVisionRange.Tooltip: Raptors with this talent will remove the suit vision obstruction effect from crewmates in this radius.
infotexts.YAMJCS.CaptainProxBuffResist.Tooltip: Damage, bleeding and burn resistance granted to the captain while a bonded raptor is nearby, and when siccing a raptor. example: 0.3 = 30% resistance.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SicDuration.Tooltip: How long (in seconds) a sicced raptor keeps its bonuses, and the captain keeps their matching resistance buff.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SicCooldown.Tooltip: Time (in seconds) before the same raptor can be sicced again.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SicMoveBonus.Tooltip: Movement speed bonus a raptor gains while sicced, on land and in water. example: 0.1 = +10% speed.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SicAttackBonus.Tooltip: Bonus attack damage a raptor deals while sicced. example: 0.25 = +25% damage.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SicStunResist.Tooltip: Stun resistance a raptor gains while sicced. example: 0.5 = 50% stun resist.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepWindupTime.Tooltip: The amount of time, in seconds, it takes for raptors to fall asleep (talent required).
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealSelfDamage.Tooltip: The amount of damage per second that sleeping raptors heal for.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealSelfBurn.Tooltip: The amount of burn per second that sleeping raptors heal for.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealSelfBleeding.Tooltip: The amount of bleeding per second that sleeping raptors remove.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealSelfBloodLoss.Tooltip: The amount of blood loss per second that sleeping raptors heal for.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealOthersDamage.Tooltip: The amount of damage per second that sleeping raptors heal their allies for.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealOthersBurn.Tooltip: The amount of burn per second that sleeping raptors heal their allies for.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealOthersBleeding.Tooltip: The amount of bleeding per second that sleeping raptors remove from their allies.
infotexts.YAMJCS.SleepHealOthersBloodLoss.Tooltip: The amount of blood loss per second that sleeping raptors heal their allies for.
infotexts.jobdescription.playerMudraptorJob: The return of Man's best friend.
infotexts.yamjMsg.cantUseItem: you don't know how to use that yet
infotexts.yamjMsg.cantRepair: you don't know how to repair that yet
infotexts.yamjMsg.cantSteer: you don't know how to steer
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjBackpack: A backpack for storing ammunition, suits, and children.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjBackpackBio: A large, luminescent backpack for storing ammunition, suits, and children.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjBackpackCaravan: A massive, heavy backpack for storing large items, containers, and children. Reduces movement speed by 25% while worn.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjFlare: A bright sponge that glows when in contact with skin.
infotexts.entitydescription.raptorGuitar: A dark blue guitar created by the one and only Guitar Raptor.
infotexts.entitydescription.raptorCowboyHat: Be rootin', be tootin', be shootin', but most importantly, launch nuclear shells at pirates.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjHelmetBasic: A strong helmet made to fit the mudraptor.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjHelmetPirate: A strong pirate helmet made to fit the mudraptor.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjArmorBasic: Strong piece of armor for the mudraptor (don't equip as a human).
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjArmorPirate: Strong piece of pirate armor for the mudraptor (don't equip as a human).
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjArmorVeteran: Strong piece of veteran armor for the mudraptor (don't equip as a human).
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjArmorClown: Strong piece of clown armor for the mudraptor (don't equip as a human).
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjArmorRemover: A special tool for removing armor from your friendly mudraptors.
infotexts.entitydescription.jumpTalentItem: After injecting this, you gain the ability to jump by ragdolling. Very useful for mudraptors.
infotexts.entitydescription.yamjRiotShield: A shield made of mudraptor shell, capable of stopping small arms fire.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjCanUseTools: Learn to properly hold and use tools.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjSpeechBasic: Gain the ability to speak, and learn a few basic words.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjArmor: Gain the ability to form a hard shell and an extra [amount]% reduction to damage
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjEgg: Gain the ability to foster mudraptor eggs, and the recipe for mudraptor shields to protect them.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjFlare: Gain the recipe for Bio Flares, sponges that glow very brightly when held. Gain one after every mission.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjSleepTime: Ragdolling for [seconds] seconds grants the Sleepy Raptor bonus, healing damage over time but only while on land. Burn recovery rate is much slower than normal damage recovery during this effect.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBackpack: Make mudraptor backpacks. 5 slots for small/medium items and 1 slot for children. Can store suits and ammo boxes.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjFlareIce: An ice cold sponge that glows very brightly when held. It slows down any hostiles near you while held. You generate one whenever a mission is completed. The effect of the flare does not harm yourself or humans.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjFlareFire: A flaming red hot sponge that glows very brightly when held. It slowly burns any hostiles near you while held. You generate one whenever a mission is completed. The effect of the flare does not harm yourself or humans.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBestFriend: Nearby crewmates gain +[walkspeed]% Walk/Run Speed and +[swimspeed]% Swim Speed. You both gain +[waterflowresist]% Water Flow Resistance.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjSleepTime2: Naps become stronger. Humans now also gain the [affliction] bonus if they're near you while you nap. They also gain +[bookpower]% of the Skill points from books they read while under this effect as well.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjCanOpener: Deal [amount]% more ‖color:gui.orange‖Creature Attack‖color:end‖ damage to structures.\nGain the ability to force doors open without a crowbar.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjSpeechCombat: Learn to properly hold and use weapons, and gain violent new vocabulary.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjArmorPirate: Learn new ways to protect yourself. Gain an additional [amount]% reduction to damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBackpackCaravan: Make heavy-duty mudraptor backpacks capable of storing larger items and containers. 9 slots for items, 2 for containers, 1 for children. Slows movement when equipped.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjHeatSignature: Gain the ability to sense nearby bodies.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjGunner: Learn to operate the submarine's turret periscopes, and deal [amount]% more damage with them.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjHumanoid: Gain a [amount]% power increase to melee weapons and firearms.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjArmorVet: Gain the ability to form a hard carapace and helmet capable of withstanding the toughest of blows. Gain an additional [amount]% reduction to damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjNeurotoxin: Your creature attack will occasionally launch a ball of caustic spit.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBloodthirsty: The scent of your own blood only fuels your frenzy.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjFamiliarWaters: It's all coming back to you. While submerged in water, you gain the following:
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjMonsterInstinct: The old ways of combat are strong in your mind. Your creature attacks gain [damage]% damage and [piercing]% piercing.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjRelentless: Your eyes glare with a burning passion for blood. Gain +[speed]% Speed and +[health]% Max Health.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjRelentless2: Whenever you fall below 0 health, you will remain fully conscious for [duration] seconds and your attacks receive +300% power.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjSpeechAdvanced: Learn several new words, as well as the names of most foreign items. Gain [amount]% [poisonresist]. Gain [amount]% [burnresist].
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBackpackBio: Make mudraptor backpacks lined with glowing chemicals. 7 slots for items, 2 for children.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjGuitarRaptor: Anyone hearing your music will be invigorated with the desire to do more, gaining a +10 bonus to All Skills. If you keep playing, people around you will gain 10 XP at random.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjGuardianAngel: Enemies will prioritize attacking you over your allies, and you take [amount]% less damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjClownCollege: The Honkmother's reach goes far in these deep dark waters...
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjMachinist: All crewmembers besides yourself can craft items at [amount] higher quality.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjHunger.veryLow: A faint restlessness... subject is hungry.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjHunger.low: A gnawing pain resides in the stomach.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjHunger.medium: Focus is faltering, subject is drooling.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjHunger.high: Sluggish and weak, showing clear signs of malnutrition.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjHunger.veryHig: Experiencing severe malnutrition. A frantic surge of energy burns through what remains as the body begins to fail.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjSatiated.low: A well-fed raptor is a happy raptor.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjSatiated.high: Subject is showing signs of postprandial somnolence. Sluggish and drowsy.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjGuardianSelf: Drawing attention away from nearby allies.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjBestFriendBuff: The Mudraptor close to you is bolstering your actions. ‖color:gui.green‖+20%‖color:end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Walk/Run Speed.‖color:end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖+40%‖color:end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Swim Speed.‖color:end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖+75%‖color:end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Water Flow Resistance.‖color:end‖
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjSleepTimeIcon: While under the effects of Raptor Nap, your vitality is slowly regenerating. Reading a Book near the snoozing raptor is bound to be really relaxing.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjGuitarRaptorBu: Guitar Raptor's songs invigorate you with a passion to do more.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjFamiliarWaterB: You know exactly what you're doing and where you are.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBondCaptain: The captain chose you for a reason. Learn to steer using the navigation terminal. You are marked on the sonar. The captain always knows where you are. You always know where the submarine is. When nearby, the captain gains [resist]% resistance to damage, bleeding, and burns. Every [cooldown]s, the captain can sic you for [duration]s, granting: +[speed]% speed +[attack]% attack power +[stun]% stun resist Immunity to unconsciousness and death During your frenzy, the captain is provided with [awayResist]% damage resistance.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjBondCaptainBuf: Bolstered by the effects of the best raptor around.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBondDoctor: Hopefully your crewmates are immune to whatever you're harboring... You gain the medic's [geneHarvester] talent, allowing you to find genetic material in corpses. You and your allies gain [burnResist]% resistance to [burn] and [poisonResist]% resistance to [poison]. You can store genetic material in your gut, identifying and refining it over time. All player raptor bites have a strong chance to be poisonous.
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBondSecurity: Your creature attacks charge up over [maxCharge] seconds. A fully charged attack deals +[damageBonus]% damage and applies up to [stun] seconds of stun. You can designate a crewmate as a handler, and their attacks will apply a mark to targets. Marked targets are visible through walls, and creature attacks against them refund [refund] seconds of cooldown for the charged bite.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjBiteCharge: Fully charged and ready to nibble!
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBondEngineer: Hanging out with the Engineer might have resulted in a little bit too much radiation intake. ‖color:red‖WORK IN PROGRESS‖color:end‖ Gain the ability to eat fuel rods. They digest slowly, but aren't very healthy...
infotexts.talentdescription.yamjBondMechanic: You gain the mechanic's [scrapSavant] talent, allowing you to find more scrap when looting. You can sense ores at a distance and through walls. Your creature attacks can mine ores. Your gut can store ore, scrap, and ammo metals. Having ore in your gut provides 15% damage and stun resistance (non-stackable). Having ammo metals in your gut allows you to spit shrapnel.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjVouchBuff.self: Mudraptors should leave you alone, for now...
infotexts.afflictiondescription.yamjVouchBuff.othe: The subject carries traces of mudraptor pheromones. The scent is fading.
The subject is saturated with mudraptor pheromones and is unlikely to be recognized as prey.
